purpose: Field registry for the Cell-Cell Communication Layer 2 method-selection evidence package.

fields.name: Tool Name
fields.definition: Canonical method or tool identity in the frozen topic candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use the frozen candidate name exactly. Do not add methods or count excluded registry rows.
fields.topic_relevance: Defines the row identity.

fields.name: Method Family
fields.definition: Short algorithm-family label.
fields.fill_rule: Use the Layer 1 method-family cue, corrected by bounded method evidence when needed.
fields.topic_relevance: Separates database, graph, transport, neighborhood, spatial-variance, and pathway-aware CCC approaches.

fields.name: Main Input
fields.definition: High-level input picture for the method in this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use object-level input phrasing, not parameter lists or callable signatures.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes expression, spatial coordinates, cell labels, LR databases, scRNA references, and pathway inputs.

fields.name: Main Use in This Topic
fields.definition: Main role of the method inside Cell-Cell Communication.
fields.fill_rule: Describe only the CCC role; do not promote unrelated ecosystem or downstream functions.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps broad tools and cross-task methods scoped to this analysis problem.

fields.name: Main Output
fields.definition: High-level output object relevant to this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use a short object-level phrase such as communication network, LR pairs, neighbor-preference scores, or pathway reconstructions.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes LR calls, graph outputs, neighborhood scores, variance components, and causal-pathway summaries.

fields.name: Closest Alternatives
fields.definition: Nearby alternatives from the same frozen candidate set.
fields.fill_rule: Use two to four local alternatives only; do not create global rankings.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports branch-local comparison.

fields.name: Key Difference
fields.definition: Main decision difference versus nearby alternatives.
fields.fill_rule: Use one decision-level sentence grounded in method family and evidence notes.
fields.topic_relevance: Provides method-selection logic without default claims.

fields.name: Compute Requirement
fields.definition: Coarse compute requirement only.
fields.fill_rule: Use the frozen registry cue when supported; do not infer runtime support.
fields.topic_relevance: Acts as a resource gate after task fit is established.

fields.name: Memory Burden
fields.definition: Coarse memory burden.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Prefer unclear when direct public support is weak.
fields.topic_relevance: Captures practical uncertainty without execution claims.

fields.name: Scale Sensitivity
fields.definition: Coarse sensitivity to large spatial datasets, high-resolution assays, or many samples.
fields.fill_rule: Use low, medium, high, or unclear. Be conservative unless direct evidence supports the label.
fields.topic_relevance: Flags methods that may require extra scrutiny for atlas-scale or single-cell-resolution CCC.

fields.name: Code Access
fields.definition: Current public access state for method code or primary use surface.
fields.fill_rule: Record access state only; do not equate access with BioHarness runtime support.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports later audit triage.

fields.name: Primary Code Link
fields.definition: One primary code, web-server, or official documentation location when verified.
fields.fill_rule: Fill only when a bounded source confirms a primary location; otherwise leave blank.
fields.topic_relevance: Gives the later audit a starting point without creating execution status.

fields.name: Evidence Source
fields.definition: Compact source trace for PMID, DOI, code-link, or benchmark/review source.
fields.fill_rule: Include PubMed PMID/DOI and code-link source where available.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps evidence traceable to bounded retrieval and frozen input.

fields.name: Evidence Note
fields.definition: Short note separating direct evidence from Layer 2 synthesized judgment.
fields.fill_rule: Explicitly say which claims are direct evidence and which are Layer 2 judgment.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents method-paper claims from becoming overbroad selection claims.

fields.name: Best First Choice When
fields.definition: Branch-local condition under which the method is a good initial candidate to read or evaluate.
fields.fill_rule: Use conditional selection language. Do not write global default-method claims.
fields.topic_relevance: Supports conditional method selection.

fields.name: Do Not Start With This When
fields.definition: Branch-local condition under which this method is not the first candidate.
fields.fill_rule: Use caveated selection language; do not exclude from all later consideration.
fields.topic_relevance: Prevents poor task-method fit.

fields.name: CCC Branch
fields.definition: Primary Cell-Cell Communication branch represented by the method.
fields.fill_rule: Choose the smallest useful branch label; use Layer 1 subtask as a cue, not a separate package.
fields.topic_relevance: Keeps LR, relay, neighborhood, variance, comparison, and causal interpretation branches separate.

fields.name: Spatial Specificity
fields.definition: How directly the method uses spatial information.
fields.fill_rule: Use a concise phrase such as coordinate-aware, spatial co-expression, neighborhood graph, non-spatial baseline, or spatial use case.
fields.topic_relevance: CCC methods differ strongly in whether spatial proximity is central or merely an application context.

fields.name: Ligand-Receptor Dependence
fields.definition: Whether LR pairs/databases are required, optional, downstream, or not primary.
fields.fill_rule: Use required, optional, downstream / user-supplied, not primary, or unclear.
fields.topic_relevance: Distinguishes molecular LR inference from cell-label neighborhood preference and pathway interpretation.

fields.name: Resolution / Grouping Level
fields.definition: The biological or computational resolution at which the method mainly reports CCC.
fields.fill_rule: Use object-level labels such as cell group, single cell, spot, LR pair, interface, sample, or pathway.
fields.topic_relevance: Resolution strongly affects interpretability and benchmark comparability.

fields.name: Reference / Annotation Dependence
fields.definition: Main dependence on cell annotations, scRNA reference, LR database, prior networks, or user-defined inputs.
fields.fill_rule: State the dominant dependency; use unclear if not verified.
fields.topic_relevance: Captures bias sources that change branch-local method choice.

fields.name: Primary Scientific Risk
fields.definition: Most important scientific caveat for interpreting the method in this topic.
fields.fill_rule: Use one concise risk statement; separate methodological uncertainty from direct evidence.
fields.topic_relevance: Carries Scientific Critical Thinking caveats into selection without overclaiming evidence strength.
